description: Test file for approval callback data handling in the Telegram extension, containing unit tests for functions like fitsTelegramCallbackData, rewriteTelegramApprovalDecisionAlias, and sanitizeTelegramCallbackData.

methods.name: fitsTelegramCallbackData
methods.description: Checks if the callback data string fits within Telegram's byte boundaries.

methods.name: rewriteTelegramApprovalDecisionAlias
methods.description: Rewrites approval callback commands to a canonical form, e.g., '/approve <id> allow-always' to '/approve <id> always'.

methods.name: sanitizeTelegramCallbackData
methods.description: Sanitizes callback data by enforcing byte length constraints, dropping data exceeding 64 bytes.
